result.brief: 提出免训练扩散加速框架 BeziCast，用 Tikhonov 稳定拟合的低阶 Bezier 轨迹预测去噪表征，并加凸包护栏抑制外推风险，在 FLUX 与 HunyuanVideo 上取得显著加速且保真更好。
result.reason: Training-free feature caching/forecasting to accelerate diffusion inference; abstract reports gains on video diffusion (HunyuanVideo), a concrete transfer to video generation efficiency.
